quote_source: Eastmoney kline fqt=0 and fqt=2, daily, cutoff20261110
corporate_action_source: Sina ETF hfq.js cumulative share multiplier s and cumulative cash u; require f=1
signal_price: raw_close*s+u, chronological cumulative-unit adjusted close; no future factor application
holding_value: one entry share: price_t*(s_t/s_entry)+(u_t-u_entry)/s_entry, cash dividends held as cash/receivable; no forced reinvestment
dividend_timing: economic entitlement at ex-date, payment-date cash settlement not modeled
factor_validation: compare raw_close*s+u with vendor hfq close on exact dates; record all differences
factor_tolerance: max(0.003 currency units, 0.001*abs(vendor_hfq_price)); if more than 0.5% of matched bars exceed threshold quarantine entire symbol
quality: reject duplicate dates, nonfinite/nonpositive OHLC, inconsistent OHLC, or nonmonotone cash/share factors; record all exclusions, never swap panel based on returns
oos_warning: Historical split is retrospective and known-market context, not claimed truly unseen. Forward data after20261113 remain unavailable.
